events: What if every push made your shopping cart go three times faster?
No running in the store, sir.
Five kilometers per hour. Walking speed.
Forty five. The cereal aisle is a blur.
Four hundred. Faster than a race car. Through the front doors.
Thirty six hundred. Three times the speed of sound.
Thirty two thousand. Faster than the space station.
Three hundred thousand. Earth to the Moon in eighty minutes.
Six hundred forty five million kilometers per hour. More than half the speed of light.
The real part: the shopping cart was invented in nineteen thirty seven by a grocery store owner in Oklahoma.
